_note: Short English coaching cues, our own words (same meaning as the Arabic cues), keyed by exercise id, dataset and built-in extras alike. Shown when the app language is English.

Ab_Roller: Start on your knees with your abs braced
Roll forward only as far as you stay in control
Arnold_Dumbbell_Press: Start palms facing you and rotate them forward as you press
Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip: Pull your shoulder blades back and pin them to the bench
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest
Elbows at about 45 degrees, not flared
Press up without lifting your back off the bench
Barbell_Curl: Elbows stay pinned to your sides
Curl with the biceps, no swinging your back
Lower slowly until your arms are straight
Barbell_Deadlift: Keep the bar close to your legs the whole way
Push the floor away and lock out with your glutes
Barbell_Glute_Bridge: Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes at the top
Barbell_Hip_Thrust: Upper back on the bench, bar over your hips
Drive through your heels and lock out with your glutes
Chin tucked, don't arch your back
Squeeze your glutes for a second at the top
Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri: Set the bench to a low incline, 30 to 45 degrees
Lower the bar to your upper chest
Don't let your shoulders shrug up to your ears
Barbell_Shrug: Shrug straight up toward your ears, not back
Hold a second at the top
Barbell_Squat: Bar on your traps, not your neck
Drive through your heels, chest up
Barbell_Walking_Lunge: Back knee comes close to the floor
Drive through your heel and step forward
Bench_Dips: Keep your back close to the bench
Lower until your elbows reach 90 degrees
Bent_Over_Barbell_Row: Hinge until your back is nearly horizontal
Pull the bar to your lower chest
Bodyweight_Squat: Push your hips back and sit down
Flat back, knees over your toes
Butterfly: Set the seat so your hands are at chest height
Back against the pad, shoulders down
Bring the handles together with your chest and squeeze for a second
Cable_Crossover: Stagger your stance and lean slightly forward
Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows
Bring your hands together in front of your chest and squeeze
Cable_Crunch: Kneel and hold the rope beside your head
Curl down with your abs, not your arms
Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly: Soft, fixed bend in the elbows
Open with your rear delts, not your back
Cable_Seated_Lateral_Raise: The cable keeps tension the whole way
Lead with your elbows up to shoulder height
Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine: Press with the balls of your feet
Full range: deep stretch and full press
Chin-Up: Pull your chin over the bar
Lower slowly — that builds the biceps and lats
Close-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press: Press with your triceps to lockout
Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown: Pull your elbows down to your sides
Return slowly until the lats stretch
Concentration_Curls: Brace your elbow on your inner thigh
Curl with the biceps only, body still
Squeeze for a second at the top
Crunches: Lift your shoulders, not your neck
Squeeze your abs at the top
Dead_Bug: Lower back pressed into the floor
Move the opposite arm and leg slowly
Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press: Lock your feet in at the end of the bench
Lower the bar to your lower chest
Control it: lower slower than you press
Dips_-_Chest_Version: Lean forward a little to work the chest
Lower until you feel a chest stretch
Don't go too deep if your shoulders hurt
Dips_-_Triceps_Version: Press with your triceps to lockout
Dumbbell_Bench_Press: Lower until you feel a chest stretch
Dumbbells finish over your shoulders, not your face
Feet planted, shoulder blades pulled back
Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl: Turn your palms up as you curl
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly
Dumbbell_Flyes: Soft, fixed bend in the elbows
Open until you feel a chest stretch
Bring them together like hugging a tree
Dumbbell_Lunges: Big step forward, knee over your foot
Drive through your heel to come back
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press: Dumbbells at ear level, elbows slightly forward
Press up without arching your back
Dumbbell_Shrug: Dumbbells at your sides, back straight
Shrug toward your ears and hold a second
Dumbbell_Step_Ups: Put your whole foot on the box
Drive through the top heel, not the bottom leg
EZ-Bar_Curl: Grip the angled part of the EZ bar
Squeeze the biceps at the top
EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher: Lower the bar slowly to your forehead or behind your head
Elliptical_Trainer: Stand tall, don't lean on the handles
Face_Pull: Pull the rope to your face and spread your hands apart
Squeeze the rear delts and shoulder blades
Farmers_Walk: Weights at your sides, shoulders back
Walk with steady steps, body tall
Front_Barbell_Squat: Elbows high, bar on the front of your shoulders
Sit down and focus on the quads
Glute_Kickback: Kick back with your glutes, not your lower back
Squeeze for a second at the top
Goblet_Squat: Hold the dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest
Elbows inside your knees at the bottom
Good_Morning: Bar on your traps, knees slightly bent
Push your hips back with a flat back
Stand up with your glutes and hamstrings
Hack_Squat: Feet slightly forward on the platform
Lower to 90 degrees and drive up with your quads
Hammer_Curls: Palms face each other the whole time
Hanging_Leg_Raise: Hang with your shoulders pulled down, not loose
Raise your legs with your abs, no swinging
Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions: Set the pad under your hips, not your stomach
Lower with a flat back and rise to a straight line
Incline_Dumbbell_Curl: Back on the bench, arms hanging slightly behind you
Biceps get a big stretch at the bottom
Incline_Dumbbell_Flyes: Open in a wide arc with soft elbows
Bring them together with your chest, not your shoulders
Incline_Dumbbell_Press: Low incline to hit the upper chest
Lower slowly and feel the chest stretch
Press up and bring the dumbbells close without clanking
Inverted_Row: Body in a straight line, bar at chest height
Pull your chest to the bar and squeeze your shoulder blades
Jogging_Treadmill: Eyes forward, not at your feet
Kettlebell_One-Legged_Deadlift: Balance on one leg with a soft knee
Push your hips back as the other leg goes behind
Knee_Hip_Raise_On_Parallel_Bars: Back on the pad, shoulders down
Raise your knees to your chest with your abs
Leg_Extensions: Set the seat so your knee lines up with the machine pivot
Lift with your quads and squeeze for a second
Leg_Press: Back and hips pressed into the pad
Lower to 90 degrees without your hips curling up
Don't lock your knees at the top
Leverage_Chest_Press: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest
Press until your arms are almost straight
Return slowly and feel the chest stretch
Leverage_High_Row: Chest on the pad, back straight
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end
Lying_Leg_Curls: Curl until the hamstrings fully contract
Lower slowly without the weights clanking
Machine_Bench_Press: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest
Press with your chest, don't fully lock your elbows
Machine_Shoulder_Military_Press: Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height
Press up without fully locking your elbows
Mountain_Climbers: Drive your knees fast with abs braced
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row: Hand and knee on the bench, flat back
Pull the dumbbell to your hip
Don't twist — pull with your back, not your shoulder
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings: Power comes from the hips, not the arm
Lock out with your glutes at the top
Pallof_Press: Cable at your side, body tall
Press your hands out and resist the rotation
Plank: Straight line from head to heels
Elbows under shoulders, don't let your hips sag
Preacher_Curl: Chest and back of your arm on the pad
Lower slowly, don't fully lock out at the bottom
Squeeze the biceps at the top
Pull_Through: Stand facing away from the cable, rope between your legs
Push your hips back with a flat back
Lock out with your glutes at the top
Pullups: Start by pulling your shoulder blades down
Pull your chest up to the bar
Pushups: Straight line from head to heels
Lower your chest close to the floor
Brace your abs and glutes throughout
Recumbent_Bike: Set the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom
Reverse_Crunch: Lift your hips off the floor, not just your legs
Reverse_Machine_Flyes: Open with your elbows and squeeze the rear delts
Romanian_Deadlift: Soft, fixed bend in the knees
Push your hips back, bar close to your legs
Lower until you feel the hamstrings stretch, back flat
Rope_Jumping: Small hops on the balls of your feet

Rowing_Stationary: Legs first, then back, then arms
Russian_Twist: Lean back slightly with abs braced
Rotate your shoulders and chest, not just your hands
Seated_Bent-Over_Rear_Delt_Raise: Chest over your thighs, back flat
Raise the dumbbells out with soft elbows
Squeeze the rear delts and shoulder blades

Seated_Calf_Raise: Knees at 90 degrees, pad on your thighs

Seated_Leg_Curl: Set the pad so your knee lines up with the machine pivot
Curl with your hamstrings and squeeze for a second
Side_Bridge: Elbow under your shoulder, body in a straight line
Lift your hips until your body is level
Don't rotate your hips forward or back
Side_Lateral_Raise: Soft elbows, raise to shoulder height
Lead with your elbows, not your hands
Smith_Machine_Bench_Press: Set the bench so the bar lands on your lower chest

Smith_Machine_Incline_Bench_Press: Lower the bar to your upper chest
Smith_Machine_Squat: Feet slightly in front of the bar
Squat until your thighs are parallel
Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells: One foot forward, one back, torso upright
Drop straight down until the back knee nears the floor
Standing_Biceps_Cable_Curl: The cable keeps tension the whole way
Squeeze the biceps at the top
Standing_Calf_Raises: Rise onto your toes as high as you can

Push your hips back, back flat
Lower until you feel the hamstrings stretch

Sumo_Deadlift: Feet wider than shoulders, toes slightly out
Push the floor away with your glutes and hamstrings
Superman: Lift arms and legs together using your back and glutes
Hold a second at the top
T-Bar_Row_with_Handle: Drive your elbows back instead of curling
Squeeze your middle back at the end
Thigh_Abductor: Set the seat, back against the pad

Return slowly without the weights clanking

Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback: Elbow fixed at your side, only the forearm moves
Triceps_Overhead_Extension_with_Rope: Elbows close to your head and fixed
Extend overhead and feel the triceps

V-Bar_Pulldown: Pull the handle to your chest
